title: Prompt Vault — Coding Conventions
purpose: Coding standards and conventions to preserve when adding or modifying code in Prompt Vault.
hard_rules: Never add business logic to route handlers in server/routes.ts — keep routes thin
Never query the database directly from routes — always use server/storage.ts
Never hardcode API route path strings — use constants from shared/routes.ts
Never persist AI chat messages to the database — session-only
Never modify vite.ts or vite.config.ts without a very strong reason
Never edit package.json scripts — ask the user first
Never use process.env on the frontend — use import.meta.env.VITE_* instead

adding_a_feature: 1. Define or update table in shared/schema.ts
2. Run npm run db:push to migrate
3. Add method to IStorage interface in server/storage.ts
patterns.data_fetching: Always use TanStack Query useQuery with typed generics and route constants as keys
patterns.mutations: Use useMutation with apiRequest from lib/queryClient. Always invalidate cache on success.
patterns.cache_keys: Use array keys for hierarchical invalidation: ['/api/prompts', id] not ['/api/prompts/${id}']
patterns.forms: Use shadcn Form + react-hook-form + zodResolver. Always provide defaultValues.
patterns.imports: Use @ prefix paths for src imports. @assets/ for static files. @shared/ for shared code.
patterns.icons: lucide-react for UI icons. react-icons/si for company/brand logos.
patterns.routing: Use Wouter Link component or useLocation hook — never window.location directly

testing_ids.rule: Add data-testid to all interactive and meaningful display elements

theming.dark_mode: Use explicit light/dark class variants when not using tailwind config utility classes
theming.css_variables: Define custom properties as H S% L% (space-separated, no hsl() wrapper) in index.css
theming.shadcn_components: Always use @ path imports for shadcn components from components/ui/

state_management.server_state: TanStack Query — all data from the backend
state_management.local_ui_state: React useState or useReducer within components
state_management.persistent_local: localStorage for settings/preferences. IndexedDB for binary handles (vault).
state_management.global_bridge: window.__setDraggingPromptId — intentional global for drag state across component trees
